title: Stage B small root on the host: NAT-096's Stage A small root (18 Apple plists without lsd + the ps heartbeat) plus exactly three files: LaunchDaemons/com.apple.backboardd.plist as the donor's mkjobs.py writes it (Apple's plist plus StandardErrorPath=/dev/console), lib/libhakios.dylib (the donor's tracked prebuilt, IOS-014, pinned SHA-256) and etc/inject.conf (the donor's one-line list: library, backboardd, containermanagerd, containermanagerd_system) that the donor's init hands to sysctl kern.exec_inject. Built with the donor's mkapfs.py and read back by the kernel's apfs_lib; tests compare the tree with NAT-096's file by file. No image, no driver, no decision and no run: those wait for the NAT-098 reading
acceptance: docs/procedures/nat-099/build_stage_b_root.py builds artifacts/nat-099/pid1-sb2/root.apfs from NAT-096's root tree (pinned by the SHA-256 of its root.apfs) and refuses any other base, any other dylib than the pinned donor prebuilt, and a backboardd plist whose content is not Apple's plist plus the single StandardErrorPath key; build.json records every input and output hash.

The tree differs from NAT-096's in exactly three paths (the plist, lib/libhakios.dylib, etc/inject.conf), every other file byte- and mode-identical; the image is read back by the kernel's apfs_lib (files compared, mismatches empty) and by the donor's verify.py content check.

Tests (with the real artifacts, skipped when absent) check the tree difference, the inject.conf bytes, the pinned hashes and refusals; no part of this changes a native run's image: the md0 of NAT-096's image stays the same file. Nothing here ran on a phone.
